Sophia: Heads-up — saw weird token-level drift on fp8+4bit hybrid path in staging. Long prompts (>=2k tokens) showing odd repetition late in generation.
Mike: Can you paste a minimal prompt + model/config?
Sophia: Using gptx-3-large-ish, quant_profile=hybrid-fp8-int4, batching=small. Example prompt: "<sys> summarize a long transcript...". Repro rate ~20% on one traffic shard.
Tara: Is KV cache eviction involved? Longctx + mixed precision sometimes loses fp8 accumulator fidelity.
Sophia: Possibly. Telemetry shows higher per-token logprob variance after 1.6k tokens. Attached snippet: 
```
telemetry: {deg_score: 0.32, var_post: 0.14, kv_miss: 0.03}
config: hybrid: {headwise: fp8, rest: int4}
```
Ryan: Suggest adding a runtime flag to force fp8 on last N heads for longctx as a quick mitigation.
Mike: That implies changing precision handshake in runtime API. We need an opt-in field on request: precision_override: {min_heads_fp8: 2} — any objections?
Tara: Might hide the real failure mode. Prefer a detection + fallback: runtime watches deg_score and if >threshold, automatically fall back to fp8-only for that request.
Jules: +1 for automated fallback. Also need lightweight canary: sample 5% of longctx traffic through fp8-only to compare.
Sophia: Ops question — what's the expected perf hit? We need numbers for cost/latency impact.
Mike: Empirically fp8-only increases GPU throughput by ~5% but raises memory by small percent. Latency change ~+1-3ms. We'll do microbench.
Tara: Action items: (1) add deg_score sentinel in runtime, (2) expose precision_override as debug header, (3) run 1-day canary of fp8-only on representative shard, (4) add telemetry histogram of post-token var.
Sophia: I'll file a short RFC with API sketch and roll-out plan.
Ryan: Tagging @ops-bot to schedule canary window.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled for 03/18 02:00-06:00 UTC. Monitoring: per-token-deg, latency, error-rate.
Jules: Also add a unit in Optimize to recommend 'max_safe_longctx_fp8_heads' per model.
Mike: Good. If fallback is automatic, we should add a header on responses: X-Precision-Fallback: fp8-only|none.
Sophia: Awesome. I'll follow up with the RFC link and a small log sample. :thumbsup:
